answer:
Done. `addToCart` now takes an optional trailing `promoCode` parameter, and when it's provided, the request body (for both the POST add and PUT update paths) gains a `discountCode` field set to that code; when omitted, the payload is exactly as before. Only [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:33) was changed, and the file still parses cleanly.

One note: the backend repo isn't in this workspace, so I used the Shopizer cart-item request's field name for the discount code, `discountCode`, consistent with the camelCase keys already used (`product`, `quantity`, `attributes`) and the Shopizer API's cart/order-item models.

Files I looked at:
- src/redux/actions/cartActions.js — the file I edited
- src/pages/other/Cart.js — to see how promo/coupon codes are handled elsewhere
- src/util/constant.js — to confirm the cart endpoints being hit
